{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Swoop}}
[[File:GizzsGang-ToppsSotE.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang]]
{{Quote|Swoop gangs, please&mdash;don't make me laugh! The whole galaxy's afraid of these swoop gangs. ''Oh no! Save us from the swoopers, Jax!'' Let me tell you something: these guys are just puffed up womp rats. Make a big noise and they scatter. And this I know from personal experience.|[[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] on swoop gangs|<ref name="Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/89/indexp3.html|text=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues|int=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues}}</ref>}}
'''Swoop gangs''' were outlaw organizations or groups of thugs that were known for their use of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]]. Most members of swoop gangs were focused on riding swoops and participating in [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop races]], though some were also known to partake of other criminal activities. Two of the most notable swoop gangs were the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] and the [[Hidden Beks]], both based on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], had a swoop gang in his employ on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Another famous Swoop Gang were the [[Grave Tuskens]] under [[KkH'Oar'Rrhr]], which were the personal strike force for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]]. He used them to great effect for pillaging [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tombs and relics on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> Under [[Rogg]] they were placed on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], and had their base in a rest stop along the highway to [[Barons Hed]]; they patrolled and acted as "enforcers".<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

[[Jaden Korr]] was also pursued by a gang of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] riding [[Flare-S swoop/Legends|Flare-S swoop]] bikes during his [[Mission to Zonju V|mission]] to [[Zonju V]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].<ref name="JK:JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

At least one [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] swoop gang was active in [[Bartyn's Landing]] ([[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]) during the first twelve years of its existence.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Swoopgang_tfrpg.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Members of a swoop gang]]
The concept of swoop gangs was introduced into the ''Star Wars'' [[Canon|continuity]] in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''. But [[Serji-X Arrogantus]]' gang, which appears in [[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]], has officially been established as a swoop gang in ''[[Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues]]'', thus making ''Star Wars 8'' the first appearance of a swoop gang. Serji-X Arrogantus' gang do indeed ride mounts that appear to have the same function as swoops, although they are of a very different design.
